title: ***WAS*** An Excellent Meal & Grocery Organizer—No Longer!
body: I’m ***WAS*** very happy to be using Prepear. I have changed my review from a 5 star app to a 1 star review because of a recent programming change I discovered on June 8, 2020. I can no longer see unlimited recipe directions. I am given just ***3*** free in-app opportunities to see the directions. It resets the count every Monday. And simply taking a cursory look at the directions counts as a single use. They have changed their policy to see directions you’ve imported to make you 1) pay their exorbitant $60 a year to use in-app directions, or 2) force you to go back to the spammy online source I got the the recipe from—you know, the one with endless verbiage, multiple ads, and annoying pop-ups. You can’t even see directions that you have ADAPTED to make the recipe your own. This is untenable for me, and has caused me to look elsewhere for another app. I will leave my original 5 star review below to show you how it was a great app that has been ruined by greed. ORIGINAL REVIEW: The free version does a lot. Create meal plans, shop with automatic grocery lists, and collect recipes and share with friends on Facebook. The two aspects I’ve really enjoyed so far are 1) the ability to find an online recipe and add it to this app using the import option. (You can manually add your own recipes too.) It also 2) adds items in the recipe’s list of ingredients to the grocery list with a single touch. There’s a way to move items from the grocery list to the pantry if you already have them too. The paid version has prepared meal plans that are a little pricy at $9.99 a month but I got an introductory offer in an email for $1.00 and 90 days of meal plans. (I have done that but am not convinced it’s the right choice for me.) All the recipes are searchable and are free though! There are allergy (like shellfish) and diet (like gluten free) options too—quite a few of them actually. The only frustrations are glitchy procedural issues that have been reported but have not all been fixed. For example, when moving recipes the "right swipe" reveals menu options. However the revealed menu does not always disappear and results in the recipe not being visible. Exiting the app or rebooting your phone will usually solve this. Hopefully as the app matures these will be resolved.

title: Updated: Wonderful App with a few Minor Bugs

Before this app, I had started printing or writing out recipes because I have a hard time cooking with all the scrolling and my device shutting down. This is by far better than paper! I can see the ingredients list at the same time as the recipe, which is genius. I can also cross out what I’ve used or done by clicking on it. It’s one of the ways my four year old likes to help. Cook mode in the app is great. 3) The reason for me taking off one star is because when I try to filter recipes, cookbooks, etc., one of the features that I rely on in most other apps and websites, doesn’t work right now. When I click that I’m done, the app closes and my filters have been forgotten. If this is fixed, I would definitely give a five-star review and recommend this app to everyone.

title: Best Recipe/Menu Planning App Out There!
body: Count me in as a Prepear fanboy!! It’s rare that you can say that an app has changed the way you do things, but that is exactly the case with Prepear. It’s by far the best one out there that collects your recipes and handles your meal plans. I’ve tried a bunch of them - and this one handles what it does so efficiently and effectively. I’ve read a little about the developers, and the app was started by parents who were trying to figure out an easier way to handle meals, recipes, and groceries for their families - so it’s designed with an eye on being super useful and by people who are actively using this and trying to make it better. I’ve been pleased with the app updates so far, and look forward to what they have in store “coming soon”. Sure, it doesn’t have as many of the bells and whistles as other similar apps, but I didn’t find those nearly as intuitive to use - this one just plain works! Love the Prepear Mode when cooking - and the way it handles the pantry and groceries added from the meal plan is really smart. Menu planning is a breeze - and it’s really easy to plug in a menu planning service as well. I use Super Healthy Kids - and it’s changed the way my family eats. If you’ve got picky eaters like me, I don’t know of anything better out there. It’s a game changer. This is one of my most used apps by far, and I very pleased with it!

title: Prepear is Awesome!!
body: I have been looking for an app that could help with dinner time woes and have great ideas to cook that are healthy for my family! I have finally found the answer in Prepear! Dinner time and shopping have become a joy instead of the everyday..."What should I make for dinner now!" Thanks Prepear!!

title: I finally cook at home!
body: I have tried so many programs, apps, websites, books...this is the first program I have been able to successfully plan, shop and “prepear” meals! Yay for finally learning how to cook!

title: Best way to plan meals!
body: I LOVE this app! This is like Ziplist of the past but better! It’s my new Pinterest. It already comes loaded with great healthy recipes. But the beauty is that you can add your own personal recipes as well as from the web! Love that it saves pictures of the recipes from the web. Love that you get a grocery list generated by section and that you can remove ingredients already on hand. My favorite trick because of the recipe pictures is that I can hand over my phone to my kids and ask them to plan our meals for the week from my cookbook. I already know the options they’re choosing from are fab (picked by me) but then they are the ones to blame if someone doesn’t like the meal! Not every website seamlessly adds their picture or directions at times and when I add ingredients it’s not as intuitive with the typing in a minor way (plus then it’s not categorized for tour list) but all of that is a small price to pay to how many advantages it affords! I have the website up pretty much every day to ‘pin’ a recipe that comes my way!

title: Love this App
body: This is a great app! I find it very helpful with our crazy schedules. I really like that you can have a week of meals planned out for you for a small monthly fee or you can do you own. My favorite is that it creates your grocery list for you and that you can keep track of what’s in you pantry. This is such a great app for busy families!

title: I use Prepear daily.
body: I can’t believe that everyone isn’t using this app yet. It is incredibly easy to use. I’ve planned menus from scratch using recipes I’ve saved and searching for new ones, and I have also been a Prepear Gold subscriber where all the menus are done for you. Everything is customizable. Grocery lists are a cinch. I NEVER follow the meal plan as written. I go through, move meals to other days, switch stuff up for what’s already in my freezer, omit stuff on days I know will be out, etc! And the option to save recipes from outside websites alone is worth trying this app out. Updates are consistent. Help and customer service are great. Highly recommended.

title: Love it!
body: Prepare has made my hectic life so much easier. You can easily change the serving size and it will adjust the ingredients that you need accordingly. I have tried dozens of recipes so far and most were a huge hit! Thanks Prepare!!!

title: Helps me organize weekly meals for my family.
body: I really love Prepear. I am an aspiring home cook and before prepear I would find great recipes and not have a good organization for them. Not only can I search all the recipes in the app I also can add new ones to try. The ratings for individual recipes also help when I am making a dish.

title: Love it!
body: Great app!

title: Love this app!
body: Easy to use, great recipes - so many amazing features!

title: Prepear
body: I am loving the Prepear app , keeps me organized and it has great features ! I love that I can meal plan and organize my week ! I highly recommend it

title: Love this App!!
body: I love this app. Not only does it help with preparing healthy food for my family but my daughter has Type 1 diabetes and we love that most of the recipes have a carb count for dosing insulin.

title: Best recipe app!!!
body: I have looked everywhere for a great recipe app and Prepear has nailed it!!! This app is easy to use and the recipes are amazing. If you’re looking for something quick and easy this app is for you. You can also filter your search to suit your dietary needs. Well thought out app. LOVE IT!!!!

title: Prepear rocks
body: The app does some really great things. For free. You can scroll all the wonderful recipes (with pictures) and create a meal plan in seconds, really. The fact that you can add recipes from the web - directly from the app- is super awesome.

title: Game changer
body: I’ve never liked making dinner. 🤷🏼‍♀️ As a mom of four, I feel like my life revolves around food—planning it, buying it, prepping it, making it, and then cleaning it all up only to repeat a few hours later. The Prepear app has made these time intensive/tedious tasks of planning & shopping a cinch! And I love that I can bookmark so many recipes so quickly! I also love the new recipe ideas I find each week and it’s been (dare I say it?) FUN to try out new ingredients and meals. I’m a HUGE fan and this app has definitely been a game changer for me! Way to go, Prepear! 🍐🍐🍐

title: Amazing! Awesome! Love It!
body: Wow! This app rocks! I’m a homeschool mom looking for healthy meal ideas for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and this app has it all. It’s free!!! It’s so easy to use. All recipes have colorful pics, with easy step by step directions. It even helps you do a shopping list with ease. Absolutely amazing!

title: Great app especially auto grocery list!
body: I love this app! You can pull recipes from any website into it, and it formats it into ingredients and directions for you. After adding recipes to your weekly meal plan, you can click on grocery list, and there’s one list for everything you need that week in one spot! I love it!

title: My new love!
body: With a new food allergy it’s been quite the challenge. But being able to make a collection of true dairy-free options, it makes feeding the family less of a guessing game and even takes the stress off my little guy’s shoulder. Great job! Looking forward to our next meal! 😉

title: This is the best app for planning meals
body: Gorgeous pics awesome recipes easy to use and free. Love it

title: Planning, Shopping, and Cooking made easy!
body: I am not a huge fan of cooking, meal planning, or grocery shopping. This app makes all those things easy and even a little more fun. The developers have literally thought of everything, I love that my phone stays “awake” while I shop or while I’m cooking — so I don’t have to gunk up my phone while I’m trying to pull up the recipe. I used to have my recipes stored in a million different places and it has been so easy to transfer them all to one place. Can’t wait to see what’s new and coming up!

title: Best meal planner/ recipe organizer out there
body: I use this app every week to plan my meals, create a grocery list and organize my recipes. Im a working mom and this has simplified my life more than anything else I have tried. I also love that I can upload family recipes with pictures, organize and share them. Try it, you will like it!

title: Great meal planner
body: This app is reply great. Adding meals is super simple and the shopping list it generates is modifiable so when you go shopping you are not getting items you already own. I really see this as a free alternative to the boxed meal services like blue approx. It makes healthy eating simple and the Meals are really good.

title: Great!
body: So many great recipes! The meal plan is so wonderful!

title: Life Changer
body: I'm now able to prePEAR (I slay myself) decadent and delicious dinners with such a marvelous app. I used to attempt to create my own recipes, many of which were utter failures. One that comes to mind is my attempt at crepes made with cricket flour and a drizzle of balsamic vinegar and a light crust made of Crackling Oat Bran. Let's just say that this meal didn't go over well with the Mrs. I'm hoping this app will allow me to avoid a few more long, cold, sleepless nights on the old Army cot in the basement as punishment for not providing my family with a delicious, succulent meal. To the creators of this app... God Bless You.

title: I can’t even believe it!!
body: I can’t believe that there’s a section you can add your favorite recipes from other websites (copy and paste the URL) and it adds it in recipe format and adds the ingredients to your shopping list if you add it to your meal plan!!!! Just that makes it worth it to me.

title: Great way to make dinner awesome!!!
body: Knowing what to make for dinner is always stressful. This app has simplified dinner for our family. Dinner went from being a chore to something we really enjoy doing together as a family! Easy to plan, easy to shop, easy to cook!

title: So excited to meal plan!
body: This app is amazing! I can't believe I'm saying this, but I'm actually excited to meal plan. The recipes look so delicious, excited about this new healthy tool at my fingertips.
